body.statement: For fixed symbolic \(T\) and \(p\), give a support-uniform closed ordered/combinatorial classification, parameterized by the ordered adoption endpoint pattern, of the number and connectivity of loading-sign chambers, their complete sign labels and incidence poset, and the simultaneous off-diagonal-zero strata, including repeated shifted boundary coordinates and every nonsingular support-rank stratum. The classification must be expressed directly in the endpoint/lag combinatorics and must not consist of running generic CAD/QE separately on each finite support instance.

obligation.what_is_open: A support-uniform closed ordered/combinatorial theorem or formula, parameterized by the ordered adoption endpoint pattern and the memory length, that gives chamber counts and connectivity, complete sign labels, the incidence poset, and all simultaneous off-diagonal-zero strata, including repeated shifted boundary coordinates and every nonsingular support-rank stratum.
obligation.obstruction: CAD/QE already gives a terminating exact solution for each fixed finite support instance, but its instance-by-instance projection and lifting output does not expose a uniform endpoint/lag formula or recurrence showing how counts, signs, incidences, and zero strata change with ordered support and the memory length.
obligation.attempted: The project reduced the tensor to exact pair-mass polynomials, proved the support-rank graph criterion, derived positive-denominator Cramer formulas, and encoded fixed-instance membership and optimization as an exact semialgebraic CAD/QE problem.  These routes certify any supplied instance but have not yielded the requested support-uniform combinatorial classification.
obligation.partial_result: For every fixed finite rational instance, the existing exact polynomial loading-body representation and CAD/QE procedure terminate and determine the loading-sign chambers, their sign labels and incidences, and the simultaneous off-diagonal-zero locus.  The pointwise Cramer formulas also certify every loading sign and zero at a supplied rational positive law.  What remains open is a support-uniform closed structural theorem or formula, parameterized by the ordered adoption endpoint pattern and \(p\), rather than a separate CAD/QE computation for each instance.

body.justification: The exact semialgebraic loading-body representation and CAD/QE already settle every fixed finite instance, including its chamber decomposition, signs, incidences, and simultaneous off-diagonal-zero locus.  The remaining mathematical object is a support-uniform closed ordered/combinatorial theorem or formula that reveals how those features vary with the ordered adoption endpoint pattern and the memory length.
body.gap: No cited source or proved result gives a support-uniform endpoint/lag classification of chamber counts and connectivity, complete sign labels, incidence posets, and simultaneous off-diagonal-zero strata across ordered absorbing supports and memory lengths.  Running generic CAD/QE separately on each finite support is exact and terminating but does not supply that structural law.
body.consumer: Such a uniform classification would tell an analyst which loading-sign regimes and exact off-diagonal-zero designs can occur from the ordered endpoint pattern and memory length before any particular finite instance is sent to CAD/QE.
